messages:
elaine-sales: Ok team — Caldera execs signed the NDA. They want a 3-day perf POC next week. Goal: sustained 400 qps @ 95th < 220ms for the 2k-token completion path. Can ops/eng confirm feasibility? :eyes:

 tom-eng: short answer: yes with Dedicated instance sizing + KV prefix cache. Need to confirm request shape (prompt size distribution + streaming vs non-streaming). Also need their TLS/SNI requirements and if responses include user PII.

 priya-ml: For model, they asked for an Llama2-70B-ish baseline and a RedCloud-quantized 13B as fallback for cost. Suggest running both in the same run with routing to compare tail latency.

 jon-ops: Ops needs a runbook. Proposed time: Wed 09:00-12:00 UTC, smoke + steady ramp to 400 qps, 1h steady-state at target. We can reserve a Dedicated pool for that window. Also, we need a whitelist of Caldera IPs for the private control plane.

 elaine-sales: Wed works. I'll get IPs and confirm SSO questions. Pricing question from them: if we hit sustained 400 qps for 1h, what ballpark monthly committed cost would you use to justify a Dedicated quote? They want a quote to compare to in-house infra.

 tom-eng: rough math: with 2k-token average response, at 400 qps that's 800k tokens/s?? wait — math check: 400 req/s * 2k tokens = 800k tokens per second — that's obviously wrong, need per-minute. Let's do per-second properly.

 priya-ml: quick calc: 400 req/s * 2000 tokens = 800k tokens PER SECOND — that is correct math but unrealistic for sustained; maybe they meant 2k total tokens per request including prompt+resp. If sustained, we'd need multiple GPUs. For monthly committed cost, better to translate to GPU hours and estimate.

 tom-eng: ops/math cleaned: 400 req/s * 2000 tokens = 800k tokens/s -> 48M tokens/min -> 2.88B tokens/hour. For 1 hour that's 2.88B tokens. If token price on hosted is $0.0004 per token for 70B (placeholder) then cost = $1.15M for that hour — which tells us hosted pricing won't work; Dedicated reserved pricing is heavily discounted. We'll give them a Dedicated package quote after we size GPUs.

 jon-ops: to be concrete, run will use: 4x A100-80GB (or equivalent), continuous batching, 4 workers behind LB. We'll pre-warm KV caches with a 15-minute priming stage (we'll supply priming script). That config should be able to sustain 400 qps with tail <220ms on 13B quantized and ~150-180ms on the 70B optimized runtime for shorter contexts. Need approval from eng on numbers.

 tom-eng: agree. Add circuit-breaker policy in routing to fallback to the quantized 13B at 99th if 70B lat spikes. Also enable streaming to reduce perceived latency for clients.

 elaine-sales: Security TODOs from Caldera: (1) SAML SSO + SCIM (2) KMS/HSM for key wrap (3) SOC2-type logging retention (4) data residency in eu-west-1. Can we cover these in Dedicated/Pvt?

 security-bot: SAML & SCIM supported in Private deployments; KMS integrations available for Dedicated via bring-your-own-key on the control plane; log retention configurable but archive needs SOC2 process. Region pinning supported for Private and Dedicated in our cloud partners.

 priya-ml: test inputs — we'll use mixed prompt shapes: 60% short (50-150 tokens), 30% medium (300-700 tokens), 10% long (1.5k-2k tokens). We'll seed the KV cache with the top 10k common prefixes to simulate snippet reuse. Load generator config (k6 style) attached below:

 ```json
 {
   "vus": 600,
   "duration": "70m",
   "stages": [
     {"duration": "10m", "target": 50},
     {"duration": "15m", "target": 400},
     {"duration": "30m", "target": 400},
     {"duration": "15m", "target": 0}
   ],
   "requests_per_iteration": 1,
   "payload_mix": {"short": 0.6, "medium": 0.3, "long": 0.1}
 }
 ```

 jon-ops: nice. For the priming script, we'll POST the 10k prefixes via the admin API. Use this curl snippet to prime cache:

 ```bash
 for f in prefixes.jsonl; do 
   curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.example/v1/prime -H "Authorization: Bearer $PRIME_TOKEN" -d @${f};
 done
 ```

 elaine-sales: Caldera legal asked about retention window for logs for the POC run (they want 90 days). Is that ok?

 security-bot: We can set 90d retention for POC audit logs. For long term enterprise contracts, we need an SLA addendum for custom retention beyond default.

 tom-eng: on observability we'll capture token-level cost, per-route p95/p99, kv-cache hit rate, and request tracing. We'll attach the dashboard link after the run.

 priya-ml: small pre-run suggestion: run a 30m smoke at 150 qps to validate model correctness and prompt latencies. We'll also check hallucination regressions with our evaluation suite.

 elaine-sales: Action items: (1) I'll send Caldera IPs + contact for SSO by EOD today. (2) Jon, please reserve Dedicated pool Wed 09:00-13:00 UTC and enable BYOK hooks. (3) Tom/priya, finalize worker count and fallback routing policy by EOD tomorrow. (4) I'll share pricing range based on your GPU-hours estimate.

 tom-eng: I'll post a sizing note with estimated GPU hours + cost delta tomorrow.

 jon-ops: Reserved window in booking calendar and created infra ticket INF-4512. Tagging: @tom-eng @priya-ml.

 elaine-sales: thanks — will update Caldera. :party_parrot:
